title: Surrender a combat sports class or registration
summary: Learn how to notify the Combat Sports Authority of NSW if you need to surrender a combat sports class or registration.
intro: If you no longer require a combat sports class or you want to surrender your registration (for example if you are moving interstate or overseas), you need to notify the Combat Sports Authority of NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Complete and submit the Combat Sports Authority form Surrender a combat sports class or registration.
